items.raw_excerpt: Las consultas empezarán en el estado el próximo 22 de agosto y hasta el 13 de septiembre; comunidades zoques de los Chimalapas rechazan consulta
items.summary_en: The state of Oaxaca will hold public consultations on a proposed indigenous law initiative from August 22 to September 13. Organizers plan nine meeting sites across the state. However, Zoque communities in the Chimalapas region have rejected the consultation process, saying it does not represent their interests.

items.raw_excerpt: Opened by Indonesian celebrities Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, La Petite Manis has drawn queues for French viennoiserie made with artisanal Indonesian ingredients – at the height of the rush, it was selling out by 2pm.
items.summary_en: La Petite Manis, an Indonesian patisserie in Paris, has attracted long queues for its French pastries made with Indonesian ingredients. The shop was opened by Indonesian celebrities Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina. It sells out by 2pm during peak hours.

items.raw_excerpt: The United Firefighters Union has lodged a dispute with South Australia's independent workplace tribunal, arguing the SA Metropolitan Fire Serivce is not providing sufficient personal protective equipment.
items.summary_en: The United Firefighters Union has filed a dispute with South Australia's workplace tribunal. The union says the SA Metropolitan Fire Service is not providing enough protective equipment for firefighters. Some gear has broken zips and sleeves that have been sewn shut.

items.raw_excerpt: Electric scooter riders will not have to make hand signals for turning and stopping when they are allowed into cycle lanes.

items.raw_excerpt: The Queensland couple is remembered for spending their money helping improve their community.
items.summary_en: Roy and Nola Thompson of Queensland spent decades donating millions to community services on the Sunshine Coast. They co-founded the region's rescue helicopter service and funded a brain and neuroscience centre. Both have died in recent weeks after nearly 70 years of marriage.
items.summary_ko: 퀸즐랜드주 선샤인코스트의 로이와 노라 톰슨 부부는 수십 년간 지역사회에 수백만 달러를 기부했습니다. 구조 헬리콥터와 뇌신경과학 센터를 공동 설립하는 등 큰 공헌을 남겼습니다. 결혼 70년 만에 최근 잇달아 세상을 떠났습니다.
items.title_en: Sunshine Coast couple who gave millions to community mourned

items.raw_excerpt: From Chinese e-bikes to TVs and air-conditioners, sexually objectifying ads continue to spark backlash. Their persistence reflects how readily women’s bodies are still used to grab attention.
items.summary_en: Sexist advertising that objectifies women continues to appear for products like e-bikes, TVs, and air-conditioners. Despite ongoing backlash, these ads persist and reflect how readily women's bodies are used to grab attention. This practice remains common in 2026.

items.raw_excerpt: Kerala High Court criticizes State for failing to collect fines on unauthorized flex boards, costing valuable revenue.
items.summary_en: Kerala High Court criticized the state government for failing to collect fines on unauthorized flex boards and banners. This failure has resulted in significant revenue loss for the state. The court emphasized the government's duty to enforce regulations.

items.raw_excerpt: A Kalbarri tourism operator says it is the first time they have seen emus swimming in one of WA's longest rivers.
items.summary_en: Tourists in Kalbarri, Western Australia, watched emus swimming in the Murchison River. A local tourism operator said they had never seen emus swim in one of the state's longest rivers. The visitors called it a lucky right place, right time moment.

items.raw_excerpt: You don't need to travel far to visit Canada's prettiest town; in fact, you don't even need to leave the province.
items.summary_en: The town of Goderich in Ontario has been named Canada's prettiest town. It sits on the shore of Lake Huron and is just steps from three beautiful blue-water beaches. Visitors can enjoy the small-town charm without traveling far from home.
